title: rbac-v2: enforce KMS region pinning + extended audit logging for residency events
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Enforce KMS region pinning at RBAC v2 evaluation time; surface residency decision events in audit logs; add migration for existing policies. Backwards-compatible enforcement can be toggled via feature flag for staged rollout.
description: Motivation: Customers in regulated regions require that keys and resources are pinned to a specific KMS region and that every residency decision is recorded in audit logs for compliance. This PR extends RBAC v2 policy evaluation to (1) validate/enforce KMS region pinning constraints for create/update operations and (2) emit structured audit events whenever residency or KMS pinning decisions are made. Scope: - Enforcement path in RBAC v2 policy evaluator (non-breaking by default behind feature flag) - Audit logging schema extension for residency/kms decisions - Migration to mark existing policies with 'residency_policy_v1' -> 'residency_policy_v2' where needed - Unit + integration tests and SDK surface docs update for the new audit fields Checklist: - [x] Implement region pinning enforcement in evaluator - [x] Add audit events and schema docs - [x] Add migration script and safety checks - [x] Update Python/TS SDK event parsing docs - [x] Add unit and integration tests - [x] Update feature flag to allow staged enablement Changes (summary): Commits: see commits field. High-level files changed: - rbac/evaluator/region_pinning.go: enforce region checks and return structured decision metadata - rbac/policy/schema_v2.go: residency rule additions and validation helpers - audit/logger/events.go: new ResidencyDecision and KMSRegionPin events + versioned schemas - migrations/2026_02_kms_region_pin.sql: migration to annotate legacy policies - sdk/python/redwood_sdk/audit.py: parser for new event fields and tests - sdk/ts/packages/audit/src/events.ts: TS types and docs - tests/integration/rbac_region_pinning_test.go: integration tests exercising policy combos Backwards compatibility and rollout: Enforcement is gated by the feature flag feature.enforce_rbac_v2_kms_region_pinning. When off, system will only emit audit events and warnings. The migration annotates policies but does not change runtime behavior until flag is enabled. Security review notes: - We validate requester KMS regions against policy KMS_residency entries and deny on mismatch. - Decision metadata includes: requested_kms_region, allowed_regions, rule_id, decision (allow/deny), and audit_reason. - Audit event payloads are small and do not include unredacted secrets. Performance: Evaluator adds a quick region string comparison and optional lookup of policy KMS metadata; measured <0.2ms median added latency in local microbenchmarks for policy evaluation path. See perf notes in commits. Testing: - Unit tests cover policy schema parsing and evaluator decisions - Integration tests run with live sqlite-backed policy store and mock KMS metadata service - CI updated to run audit schema validation step Migration plan: - Deploy with feature flag off; run migration job (included) to annotate policies - Enable audit-only mode (feature.flag: emit_only) for one week to observe events - Flip enforcement in canary, monitor SLOs and compliance dashboards Rollout/Merge: - Addressed review feedback and added one additional integration test to exercise policy precedence - Merged via squash.

notes_for_ops: When enabling enforcement, run the migration job and keep audit-only mode for 7 days. Monitor 'residency.decision' metric and 'rbac.residency_denied' alert. Feature flags: feature.enforce_rbac_v2_kms_region_pinning and feature.emit_rbac_residency_audit. Rollback: flip enforcement flag off and re-evaluate migration annotations.
changelog_entry: Security: RBAC v2 now supports enforceable KMS region pinning and emits residency decision audit events. Feature gated for staged rollout.
testing_instructions: 1) Apply migration script to a snapshot DB. 2) Deploy service with feature.emit_rbac_residency_audit=true and feature.enforce_rbac_v2_kms_region_pinning=false. 3) Run integration test suite in tests/integration/. 4) Inspect audit logs for ResidencyDecision events and verify fields. 5) Flip enforcement to true in a canary and verify deny behavior for mismatched KMS regions.
security_considerations: No secrets are written to audit logs. All KMS identifiers are redacted to key IDs only. Audit event retention defaults to 90 days per compliance policy; ops can extend retention for flagged customers. RBAC evaluator denies on region mismatch to prevent accidental data residency violations.
